literature_basis.title: Bitslicing Arithmetic/Boolean Masking Conversions for Fun and Profit
literature_basis.used_for: Composable arithmetic/Boolean gadget structure and the requirement to harden software against transition leakage.
literature_basis.boundary: The paper targets small public moduli in lattice KEMs; it does not establish this secret 521-bit dynamic-modulus construction.

literature_basis.title: On the Cost of Lazy Engineering for Masked Software Implementations
literature_basis.boundary: The abstract leakage model is not a Cortex-M33 implementation proof.

literature_basis.title: Horizontal Side-Channel Attacks and Countermeasures on the ISW Masking Scheme
literature_basis.used_for: Horizontal attacks remain an explicit adversary even for probing-secure multiplication gadgets.
literature_basis.boundary: Its results do not quantify attack success for this SQIsign component.

candidate_families.reason: It can express shared secret modulus, carries and comparisons uniformly, but a direct 544-bit schoolbook realization has prohibitive randomness and operation cost.

Addition can remain share-wise while multiplication, carry, comparison and selection use reviewed non-linear and A2B/B2A gadgets; this is the only candidate advanced to a reduced prototype, not an approved implementation.
Exponent/base/context randomization alone does not cover the 18-node scope, and the checked exponent-blinding construction has a multi-call GCD failure.
Splitting a secret but executing or storing the shares sequentially exposes exact share transitions and lacks composable non-linear gadgets.

reduced_boolean_gadget_model.sharing: For bit x choose uniform x0 and set x1=x XOR x0.
reduced_boolean_gadget_model.secure_and_schedule: Fresh r; z0=(x0 AND y0) XOR r; start z1=r and XOR x1*y1, x0*y1 and x1*y0 one at a time.
reduced_boolean_gadget_model.full_adder: a=x XOR y; sum=a XOR carry_in; carry_out=(x AND y) XOR (carry_in AND a), using two independently randomized secure-AND gadgets.

transition_counterexamples.z0_to_z1: Hamming distance equals x AND y
transition_counterexamples.sum0_to_sum1: Hamming distance equals the full-adder sum
transition_counterexamples.carry0_to_carry1: Hamming distance equals the full-adder carry

straight_line_boolean_cost_proxy.schoolbook_product_model: 544^2 partial-product secure ANDs plus 544 additions of 1088 bits, each at two secure ANDs per bit
exclusions: mask refresh beyond one bit per secure AND
straight_line_boolean_cost_proxy.interpretation: This is a reproducible cost proxy for the deliberately naive Boolean reference, not a lower bound or estimate for the selected word-arithmetic prototype.

selected_prototype_obligations: Define two-share word arithmetic over 2^32/2^64 with a reviewed multiplication gadget and fresh randomness for every non-linear composition.
Provide composable A2B/B2A conversion for carry, borrow, comparison and selector bits without recombining the secret modulus or operands.
Accept the temporary modulus already shared, derive the Montgomery inverse and radix residues without an unshared copy, and identify the upstream point where sharing begins.
Implement a reduced 2- or 3-limb C/assembly prototype first and exhaustively compare it with ordinary Montgomery multiplication, including aliases and failures.
Freeze final Cortex-M33 registers/spills and reject adjacent share transitions, unmasked temporaries, indirect recombination and compiler-dependent regressions.
Measure randomness, cycles, stack/SRAM and code size before scaling to 17 limbs; do not infer feasibility from the reduced prototype.
After scaling, compose all repeated Tonelli--Shanks powers and run ANALOG-4 first-/higher-order and horizontal attack campaigns.

next_checkpoint.name: masked_word_transition_controlled_assembly
deliverables: freeze the implemented two-limb functional oracle and its exhaustive reduced-ring value model
hand-controlled Cortex-M33 assembly for share-touching primitives
instruction-schedule HD checker plus cycle/randomness/SRAM measurement
first-order TVLA and direct transition-model attack on the frozen primitive

claim_boundary: The reduced exhaustive check establishes correctness and single-wire marginal independence only for abstract one-bit gadgets. A separate two-limb functional C oracle now exists, but it is not transition-approved. The abstract check simultaneously proves unsafe adjacent-share transitions and the cost table remains a naive reference proxy. No 521-bit masked arithmetic, composable probing proof, assembly hardening or physical result exists.
